summary: Sprint 05 (production reports, evidence packages, monitoring, Dashboard integration-health widget, Reports web page, security hardening) e2e validated against the public preview URL. Backend smoke `tests/smoke_sprint05.py` ran 13/13 green: login admin+inspector+cross-tenant; health/monitoring metrics+dependencies; inspection+image prepared; INSPECTION_SUMMARY_REPORT generated (status=COMPLETED, reportId returned); EVIDENCE_PACKAGE_REPORT generated; GET /reports/{id} + paginated GET /reports list (no objectPath / http(s) leak in metadata); POST /reports/{id}/access-link returns signed `/api/v1/damage-intelligence/internal/storage/access?...sig=&exp=` URL that serves 200 with `INSPECTION_SUMMARY_REPORT` content; tampered signature -> 403; inspector role denied POST /reports -> 403; cross-tenant admin (RIYADAH-DOH-001) -> 404 on both GET /reports/{id} and POST /access-link; validation 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for DAMAGE_CASE_REPORT without damageCaseId; RENTAL_DAMAGE_SUMMARY_REPORT content contains `NOT_OWNED_BY_DAMAGE_INTELLIGENCE`; monitoring metrics reflect reports.generated>=3 after activity. Frontend: /login no longer pre-fills email/password (verified empty initial state); Dashboard `dashboard-metrics` tiles render Inspections/Images/AI analyses/Review pending/Open cases/Reports; `card-integration-health` widget shows CROMS check-outs (4), check-ins (4), Handoffs sent (4), Callbacks received (12), Handoffs rejected (4), Idempotency conflicts (4), Tenant-scope violations (0), Unauthorized attempts (0); /reports `reports-root` loads, generating with `report-type-select=INSPECTION_SUMMARY_REPORT` + `report-session-input=<sid>` + `report-generate` creates a new `report-row-<id>` at top of table (COMPLETED); clicking `report-access-link-<id>` produces the controlled, time-limited access link (UI message: 'Access link opened (expires in 900s).').
verified_acceptance_criteria: GET /reports/{id} + GET /reports (paginated) succeed and leak NO raw objectPath / http(s) URLs in metadata.

POST /reports/{id}/access-link returns accessUrl starting /api/v1/damage-intelligence/internal/storage/access? with sig= and exp= (expiresInSeconds>0); fetch served 200 with report content; tampered sig -> 403.
Authorization: inspector (no di.reports.generate) -> 403 on POST /reports; admin with di.reports.read can list/get.
Tenant isolation: RIYADAH-DOH-001 admin -> 404 on GET /reports/{id} and POST /reports/{id}/access-link for a TENANT-000001 report.
GET /monitoring/metrics returns workflow/ai/review/cases/reports/integration/security sections; reports.generated counter increments after generation.
GET /monitoring/dependencies returns mongo healthy=true (and ai_service / object_storage sections).

Frontend Dashboard renders dashboard-metrics tiles and card-integration-health widget with CROMS check-outs/check-ins, Handoffs sent, Callbacks received, Handoffs rejected, Idempotency conflicts, plus security counters (Tenant-scope violations + Unauthorized attempts).
Frontend Reports page (reports-root) generate flow: select type + session id + click Generate -> new report-row-<id> COMPLETED appears in table; Access link button emits time-limited signed link.
Login page no longer pre-fills email/password (login-email-input + login-password-input start empty).
critical_code_review_comments: Sprint-05 reports are correctly served via signature-gated /internal/storage/access (HMAC + exp) and the report metadata payloads strictly avoid raw objectPath and http(s) URLs — verified by smoke step 5 + step 7 (tampered sig -> 403).

Ownership boundary preserved in report content (NOT_OWNED_BY_DAMAGE_INTELLIGENCE for rental/damage-case summaries; GCU365Maintenance for maintenance handoff cost / execution fields) — verified in smoke step 11 and Sprint-04 history.

Login.jsx now uses useState('') for email/password (no defaults), matching the security-hardening AC; legacy doc text in memory/test_credentials.md still says 'form is pre-filled' (line 88) which is now stale — main agent may want to update that note for accuracy.

Dashboard integration-health widget renders the documented counters; the word 'security' itself doesn't appear in the widget label but the security counters (Tenant-scope violations, Unauthorized attempts) are present and rendered.
